title: Thaumic Fifimize
description: A quality-of-life addon for Thaumcraft 5 that fixes bugs, adds automation-focused seals, boosts Silverwood sapling drops, and unlocks renewable recipes for rare resources.
body:
A quality-of-life and automation-focused addon for [Thaumcraft](https://www.minecraftforum.net/topic/2011841) 5. Fixes some bugs, reintroduces the Seal Copier, and unlocks powerful new automation tools—including powerful automation and renewable recipes for rare arcane resources. Streamline your Thaumcraft experience and eliminate progression bottlenecks with essential tweaks and upgrades.

Core Features：
- Silverwood Sapling BoostDouble the chance of Silverwood Leaves dropping saplings (fully configurable in the config file). No more struggling to grow your silverwood forest or hoarding saplings.
- Seal Copier ReturnPorted back the beloved Seal Copier from Thaumic Augmentation, letting you duplicate your seals without tedious manual set. Save time and focus on your automation setups.
- 🛠️ Seal Fixes & Upgrades
  - Fixed the critical bug where seals failed to interact with Double Chests, ensuring your storage automation works reliably.
  - Added a new Arcane Craft Seal for automated arcane crafting, reducing manual input for complex recipes.
  - "Control Seal: Use" now activates Infusion Altar, enabling fully automated infusion rituals for advanced Thaumcraft progression.
  - "Advanced Control Seal: Store" can now request items from a whitelist, making resource management smarter and more flexible.
- ♻️ Renewable Recipes Added, renewable crafting paths for previously non-renewable items like Netherrack and Shimmerleaf.
- Always keeps one when harvesting shard from a vis crystal block with a wand.
- Added a new block: Lamp of Crystal, used to accelerate the growth of vis crystals.
